findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/StructureSheaf.lean:930 `instance stalkAlgebra (p : PrimeSpectrum R) : Algebra R ((structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk p)` and :940 `instance IsLocalization.to_stalk (p : PrimeSpectrum R) : IsLocalization.AtPrime ((structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk p) p.asIdeal`; the PR's proofs use `f` only via `kernelPoint_asIdeal`.
findings.fix: State them for an arbitrary `x : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)` (`Algebra R (stalk x)` and `IsLocalization.AtPrime (stalk x) x.asIdeal`), then get the augmentation case by rewriting with `kernelPoint_asIdeal`.
findings.issue: `kernelStalkAlgebra` (74) and `kernelStalkIsLocalization` (89) are `instance`s whose heads mention `kernelPoint f`, so they fire at no other point, yet their content is point-generic: Mathlib already supplies both at every prime.

findings.evidence: Line 139: the body is `(Ideal.cotangentLocalizationEquiv (Rₚ := stalk (kernelPoint f)) (RingHom.ker f)).restrictScalars k`; `Ideal.cotangentLocalizationEquiv` (TauCeti/RingTheory/Ideal/Cotangent/Localization.lean:69) requires only `[p.IsMaximal]` and `[IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ p]`, and line 159 discharges `_toCotangent` by `exact` from the general lemma.
findings.fix: Add `cotangentLinearEquivZariski (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [x.asIdeal.IsMaximal] : x.asIdeal.Cotangent ≃ₗ[R] ZariskiCotangentSpace (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) x` with its `toCotangent` formula, and define the `f`-version as its specialization at `kernelPoint f` followed by `.restrictScalars k`; keep `kernelResidueFieldRingEquiv` and `_smul`, which are genuinely `f`-specific.
findings.issue: `kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski` (135) and `kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski_toCotangent` (146) are stated only for augmentation kernels, but nothing in them uses `f`, `k`, or `Algebra k H` beyond maximality plus a `restrictScalars`; the natural statement is at any closed point of `Spec R`.

summary: The localization core is at the natural level, but the affine-scheme layer states point-generic material only at `kernelPoint f`: the stalk algebra/localization instances and the cotangent equivalence use the augmentation only through `kernelPoint_asIdeal` and maximality of `ker f`.
